message.content:
This is a Pioneer MVH-S230BT digital media receiver, a car radio with AM/FM tuner that also plays sound from USB devices. It falls under heading 8527.21, which covers radio-broadcast receivers that can operate without an external power source, of a kind used in motor vehicles, combined with sound recording or reproducing apparatus. A receiver that plays back from USB flash memory is generally treated as combined with sound reproducing apparatus.

Heading 8527.21 has two subheadings: 8527.21.10 for radio receivers combined with laser-read systems, and 8527.21.20 for those combined with a cassette player. The remainder is 8527.21.40 or 8527.21.60, with 8527.21.40 being the one I recall as "other." For the statistical suffix I am uncertain, but I believe the 8527.21.40 line carries 00 as its suffix.

In the 2012 schedule, 8527.21.10 was "Incorporating a tape player" and 8527.21.15 was "Incorporating a laser-read system." The line 8527.21.20 was "Other, combined with sound recording or reproducing apparatus" (it replaced the older .40 and .60 lines). I recall CBP rulings for similar Pioneer units classifying them under 8527.21.4000 or 8527.21.6000, and later under 8527.21.2000 or 8527.21.4000. The current schedule has these lines:
- 8527.21.20: Incorporating a tape player
- 8527.21.40: Incorporating a laser-read system
- 8527.21.60: Other, with 8527.21.6000 as the statistical line

A USB-only unit with no laser-read system and no tape player would fall in the "Other" line, so I'll go with that.

{"hts_code": "8527.21.6000", "reason": "A car AM/FM radio receiver combined with sound reproducing apparatus (USB/Bluetooth playback), with no tape player or laser-read system, falls under 8527.21 in the 'other' line."}
